Title: Need to improve the mechanism of payment of premium under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. 

DR. K. GOPAL (NAGAPATTINAM): Pradhana Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana the new crop insurance scheme was launched last year by this government. It is better than the previous national agricultural insurance scheme. But there are many flaws in the scheme. Usually the farmers enrolment in their PAC Bank gives preference to the loanee farmers. They cause delay in enrolment of non-loanee farmers and also they are not allowed to pay the premium upto the due date. They fix a particular due date and advise the farmers to pay the premium within that date. This causes delay to accept the premium amount from the non-loanee farmers. 

Some farmers are not able to pay the premium within the date, some of them are not aware of the date. So lapse occurs and also the collected premium amount must reach the insurance company within the date. Most of the PACB and rural bank don’t have the proper internet service and have server problems. The payment details don’t reach the insurance companies properly. So the insurance companies should extend the time for at least one more month for this procedure. 

The insurance companies should set up the Common Service Centre (CSC) at village level in Thiruvarur and Nagapattinam district. They must establish 573 centers in Thiruvarur and 523 centres in Nagapattinam . But they have only less than 100 centres. Therefore, the above mentioned number of CSCs should be setup at village level immediately. 

The premium collecting agents through CSC have various duties like, registering farmers details, variety of crops, the field photo update, data entry to central government portal and state government portal. They also conduct 4 crop cutting experiments (CCE) in each village. In Thiruvarur and Nagapattinam they should conduct more than 25,000 CCE in all crops. The honorarium of the CSC agents are very low, they get only Rs.5,000 per month. So agents don’t come forward to perform the required tasks. Hence, the honorarium for the CSC staff should be paid through the government. 

The insurance amount is calculated considering the years yield, that is 5 years good yield, 2 years bad yield. Bad yield should be avoided, and also the distribution of insurance amount should be done for every village individually not district wise or lot wise.lf they give it at the village level it is easy to distribute the amount very quickly. 

In Thiruvarur, Thiruthuraipoondi, Koltur, Mutthupettai, Nannilam, Thiruvarur blocks, the threshold yield is very low. In this case they should consider only the high yield blocks and pay the insurance amount equally for all blocks. So that the insurance amount variation within the farmers will be avoided. 

Finally the insurance should pay through a government agency, because in the year 2016-17 throughout India the farmers' contribution is Rs. 2000 crores. The Central and State government’s contribution is Rs. 7000 crore. When Drought affected all over India, the insurance companies paid only Rs. 4500 crores to the farmers, the balance 4500 crore is net profit for the insurance companies. This clearly proves that the insurance companies pocket a major portion of the fund. So I advise the government to pay the insurance to the farmers through government agencies.

Title: Need to review the decision to divest Air India. 

SHRI DINESH TRIVEDI (BARRACKPUR): Air India has served the nation for decades and was always there for the service of the national call. If today it is in this financial situation it was not because of itself but successive governments that have shortchanged Air India and treated it like their private properties and at times private airlines were favoured. The government has recently proposed a strategic disinvestment of Air India and its 5 subsidiaries. Since 2015, Air India has shown healthy signs of revival, owing to the TP initiated in 2012. For the first time in 10 years, Air India reported an operating profit of 105 crores in 2015, and 205 crores in 2016. As the government operates BSNL, MTNL in communications and DD and AIR in broadcasting, it should have a national carrier too. 

I urge the Government to reconsider the decision and to work on restructuring the debt of Air India.

Title: Need to set up a branch of Life Insurance Corporation of India at Malkangiri, Odisha.

Title: Regarding new rail coach factory in Palakkad, Kerala. 

SHRI M.B. RAJESH (PALAKKAD): A new Rail Coach Factory project was announced in Rail budget, 2008 and a foundation stone was laid for the same in 2012. A request for qualification (RFQ) was floated in September 2013 but no responsive bids were received. Since then, though it was decided that the business model will be made more conducive to investment and a fresh RFQ will be floated, it has not happened. Further, the Steel Authority of India (SAIL) had shown interest in the joint venture for Coach Factory. I urge upon the Government to take immediate steps to bring this project under ‘Make in India’ and to float a fresh RFQ to explore the possibility of Joint venture with any other public sector including SAIL to get it operational in a time-bound manner.

Title: Need to review functioning of DISHA Committee. 

SHRIMATI KOTHAPALLI GEETHA (ARAKU): The Union Government constituted DISHA Committee to be chaired by Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha on 28th July, 2016 for effective development coordination of almost all important central schemes. Making a statement in Lok Sabha, the Hon’ble Minister for Rural Development has stated that this committee will monitor the implementation of 28 schemes and programmes of Ministry of Rural Development and other Ministries to promote synergy and convergence for greater impact. 

These meetings are supposed to be held once in every quarter and this is supposed to be mandatory. But in many districts, the meetings are not conducted as per the guidelines. These meetings are being reviewed by the Ministry of Rural Development as the Minutes of the DISHA committee are to be uploaded on the website of the Ministry. Hence, I would like to request the Minister for Rural Development to issue necessary instructions for the smoother conduct of DISHA, as well as evolve a policy to closely monitor and fix responsibility on district administration so as to ensure that the guidelines of the Union Government are strictly adhered to.

Title: Need to ensure speedy justice in cases of crimes against women. 

SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE (BARAMATI): A 15 year old minor was brutally raped and killed by three men in Kopardi village in Karjat taluka of Ahmednagar district of Maharashtra on 13 July, 2016. It has been a year since the assault on the minor and the victim is yet to receive justice. Even after more than a year, justice is yet to be delivered. The total number of pending cases in High Courts and Subordinate Courts, by the end of 2014, is more than three crores. Of these pending cases, 9.2% have been pending for more than ten years in these Courts. Crimes committed under Indian Penal Code (IPC) against women, as proportion of total IPC crimes have increased to 11.4 percent in 2014. Thus, I would like to bring to the notice of the Government the compelling need for the Centre to assist states in undertaking safety measures and ensuring speedy justice for women.

माननीय अध्यक्ष महोदया, मैं केवल एक मिनट में अपनी बात समाप्त करूंगा। ...(व्यवधान) यह अवसर बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है। मैं स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के सब सेनानियों को अपनी तरफ से श्रद्धा सुमन देते हुए अपने जिले के दो स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों का विशेऐा उल्लेख करना चाहूंगा। ...(व्यवधान) वऐाऩ 1942 का आंदोलन एक महत्वपूर्ण आंदोलन था, जिसमें आखिरी फांसी मेरे लोक सभा क्षेत्र के श्री राज नारायण मिश्र को हुई थी। ...(व्यवधान) उसके बाद स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में कोई फांसी नहीं हुई। ...(व्यवधान) दूसरे स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानी श्री बंसीधर शुक्ल हैं, जिनके गाये हुए गीतों को स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन और नेताजी सुभाऐा चन्द बोस की आजाद हिन्द फौज गाती थी। ...(व्यवधान)

अध्यक्ष महोदया, मैं आपके माध्यम से भारत सरकार से अनुरोध करना चाहता हूं कि इन स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों के नाम पर एक स्मारक लखीमपुर जिले में बनाया जाये। ...(व्यवधान) मैं सब स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों को अपनी श्रद्धा सुमन अर्पित करता हूं। ...(व्यवधान) मैं सदन के विरोधी पक्ष से भी अनुरोध करना चाहता हूं कि पंडित दीन दयाल उपाध्याय की जन्म शताब्दी वऐाऩ पर प्रधान मंत्री जी के टास्क का संज्ञान लेते हुए इस देश को पांच साल में एक विकसित देश बनाने के लिए अपना योगदान दें। ...(व्यवधान) इस देश के सब लोग सुखी हों, ऐसा पंडित दीन दयाल उपाध्याय जी का जो सपना था, उसे पूरा करने का काम करें। बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। ...(व्यवधान)

माननीय अध्यक्ष :  श्री सी.पी. जोशी,  कुंवर पुऐपेद्र सिंह चन्देल,  श्री शरद त्रिपाठी,  श्री रोड़मल नागर,  श्री सुधीर गुप्ता,  श्री भैरों प्रसाद मिश्र और  श्री अश्विनी कुमार चौबे को श्री अजय मिश्रा टेनी द्वारा उठाए गए विऐाय के साथ संबद्ध करने की अनुमति प्रदान की जाती है।

Title:  Need to give compensation to people who were murdered and whose houses were bruest. 

श्रीमती मीनाक्षी लेखी (नई दिल्ली) : अध्यक्ष महोदया, मैंने आज जीरो ऑवर में जो नोटिस दिया था ...(व्यवधान) मेरी फोन पर बात हुई, तो वह मैटर सॉल्व हो गया है। ...(व्यवधान) अगर आपकी परमिशन हो, तो मैं सदन में एक और इम्पोर्टैंट मैटर उठाना चाहता हूं। ...(व्यवधान)

आदरणीय अध्यक्ष महोदया, अभी रविवार को सारे अखबारों में केरल के विऐाय में दो खबरें छपी थीं। ...(व्यवधान) पहली खबर माननीय वित्त मंत्री और रक्षा मंत्री जी के दौरे के बारे में थी कि किस तरीके से वहां क्या हुआ?...(व्यवधान) दूसरी खबर एक अखबार में छपी थी कि सीपीएम की सरकार ने जुनैद के परिवार को दस लाख रुपये मुआवजा देने के बारे में तय किया है। ...(व्यवधान)

अध्यक्ष महोदया, मैं इस सदन में आपके माध्यम से यह विऐाय उठाना चाहती हूं कि हम क्वाज़ाई फेडरल स्ट्रक्चर की लगातार बात करते हैं, तो उसके तहत राज्य सरकार को राज्य के लोगों के लिए कार्रवाई करनी है। ...(व्यवधान) वहां पर 500 मकान जला दिये गये। ...(व्यवधान) 11 लोगों के घर एक दिन में जले और 30 लोगों के घर तीन दिन के अंदर जले। ...(व्यवधान) वहां 500 मकान जलाए जाने के बाद लोग बेघर हो गए हैं।...(व्यवधान) वहां 13 महीनों के अंदर 14 हत्याएंं हुई हैं, जिनमें से चार दलित लोगों की हत्या हुई है। उनके लिए राज्य सरकार ने कोई कंपनसेशन नहीं दिया।...(व्यवधान)

मैं आपके माध्यम से मांग करती हूं कि उन लोगों को कंपनसेशन मिले, क्योंकि यह राज्य का केवल अधिकार नहीं, बल्कि कर्त्तव्य है। ...(व्यवधान) अपने कर्त्तव्यों में सीपीएम सरकार लगातार विफल होती दिखाई दे रही है और जुनैद के नाम पर राजनीति करना चाहती है।...(व्यवधान)

माननीय अध्यक्ष:  श्री शरद त्रिपाठी,  कुँवर पुऐपेद्र सिंह चन्देल,  श्री शिवकुमार उदासि,  श्री देवजी एम. पटेल,  डॉ. वीरेद्र कुमार,  डॉ. किरिट पी. सोलंकी,  श्री निशिकान्त दुबे,  डॉ.मनोज राजोरिया,  प्रो. रिचर्ड हे एवं  श्री भैरों प्रसाद मिश्र को श्रीमती मीनाक्षी लेखी द्वारा उठाए गए विऐाय के साथ संबद्ध करने की अनुमति प्रदान की जाती है।
